acquisition_method: The mass spectrometer was operated in data-dependent (dd) positive acquisition mode
cleavage_agent: Enzymatic digestion was performed with Trypsin/LysC (2 µg) overnight at 37 °C at 1000 rpm.
collision_energy: subsequent HCD MS/MS of the 10 most intense peaks from the full scan (normalized collision energy of 27%)
fragmentation_method: subsequent HCD MS/MS of the 10 most intense peaks from the full scan
instrument: This equipment is composed of an Ultimate 3000 liquid chromatography system coupled to a Q-Exactive Hybrid Quadrupole-Orbitrap mass spectrometer
labeling: inferred: Protein label-free quantitation was performed with the Minora feature detector node at the processing step.
mass_analyzer: inferred: This equipment is composed of an Ultimate 3000 liquid chromatography system coupled to a Q-Exactive Hybrid Quadrupole-Orbitrap mass spectrometer
ptm: Cysteine carbamidomethylation, Methionine oxidation, protein N-terminus acetylation
Cysteine carbamidomethylation was defined as constant modification. Methionine oxidation and protein N-terminus acetylation were defined as variable modifications.
